work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent act XXIV has synopsis 58049–58052, its own marginal summary 58055–58060, protocol 58065–58066 and complete sections 1–2 through original dating 58122–58124 and editorial dating 58125. Its recital of Alexander VII 1666 indulgence is embedded antecedent testimony and is retained. Trims only detached opening-label tail at 58128, which belongs to following XXV at 58131 and incipit 58141, as the context proves. No historical note is lost by trimming this next-act marginal label. Substantive-extent re-audit: The current confirmation is printed at 58115–58120; the earlier 1666 indulgence and its conditions are retained in the preceding historical recital. The operative disposition is not replaced by editorial shorthand.
